blurb: Diamond Nights brings the iconic music of Neil Diamond to life with an electrifying tribute performance at GTS Theatre. Featuring Gil Downer, this show celebrates the legendary singer-songwriter's timeless hits through an engaging atmosphere that invites audience participation. Sing along to beloved classics and relive the magic of Diamond's heartfelt ballads and energetic anthems. Whether you’re a devoted fan or new to his music, this tribute promises a night filled with nostalgia and joy, making it a perfect evening out in Myrtle Beach.
